thread.title: Nasdaq Up Again; This Sector Produces New Breakouts | Investor's Business Daily

author: DAVID SAITO-CHUNG
title: Nasdaq Up Again; This Sector Produces New Breakouts | Investor's Business Daily
text:
The Nasdaq composite outperformed other key indexes for a second straight day, while investors seemed to lighten up their defensive tone in stocks today.
X Ahead of key fiscal fourth-quarter results from Apple ( AAPL ) after the close, volume on the Nasdaq was running mildly lower despite the tech-weighted index's more than 1.4% gain.
The Street sees Apple earning $2.78 a share, up 39%, in the September-ended fiscal fourth quarter. The range of estimates tracked by Thomson Reuters goes from a low of $2.65 (up 28%) to as high as $2.90 (up 40%).
Meanwhile, the health care sector continued to warm up with new breakouts and continued strength by names that cleared new bases in recent months. On Thursday, they now include Ensign Group ( ENSG ), which spanked the bears with a 15% gain and made a new high of 43.76. The proper buy point in Ensign's new flat base : 40.19.
The 5% proper buy zone for the nursing facility operator goes up to 42.20.
Will Medical, Health Care Stocks Fortify The Nasdaq? Other health care sector stocks worth watching may include Abiomed ( ABMD ), the heart pump innovator; HSA account administrator HealthEquity ( HQY ); robotic surgery pioneer Intuitive Surgical ( ISRG ); and low-cost insurance plan provider Health Insurance Innovations ( HIIQ ). All four of these companies, many of which have appeared in IBD growth stock lists including the IBD 50 , Big Cap 20 , and Sector Leaders , are now forming new bases .
Bases simply denote a period of time in which a market leader pauses during its long-term price run, then sets up a new proper buy point .
A good base can, in a confirmed market uptrend, lead to promising new breakouts to new highs and profits for stock investors who can use charts to their advantage.
Abiomed on Thursday reported strong Q3 results, with earnings rising 84% to 81 cents a share on a 37% jump in revenue to $181.8 million. That's the biggest quarterly revenue for any quarter in the Danvers, Mass., company's history. Shares surged more than 6% higher and retook the critical long-term 200-day moving average.
The stock, however, still is swimming underneath its 50-day line and stands 21% below a 52-week peak. In other words, plenty of base-building work remains.
The Nasdaq Leads The Stock Market Today The strong rebound by the Nasdaq composite follows a 1.6% jump on Tuesday and a 2% gain Wednesday. The Philadelphia semiconductor index, also known as the SOX, jammed 4.4% higher as it too rallied sharply for the third day in a row.
Defensive stocks slipped after moving sharply up in October. The Dow Jones utility average dropped 1%.
FANG stocks traded mixed, yet the rally on the Nasdaq is proving broad-based. Winners smacked losers by a more than 5-2 ratio on the Nasdaq.
Volume rose vs. the same time Wednesday on the NYSE, a promising sign given that the S&P 500 rallied 0.8% on top of Wednesday's 1.1% lift.
A Broad Advance Among Blue Chips The Dow Jones industrial average gained 0.8% as seven of its 30 components rose 2 points or more.
DowDuPont ( DWDP ), a member of the Dow Jones industrials, jumped more than 7% and is trying to recoup some of its severe losses in recent weeks. The chemical giant issued a brilliant quarterly report as earnings jumped 35% to 74 cents a share, beating the Thomson Reuters consensus view by 3 cents. Revenue climbed 31% to $20.1 billion.
Among IBD's 197 industry groups tracked each day, at least 18 groups thrust 4% higher or more. They included mortgage services, truck, gaming, RV, generic drugs, semiconductor equipment, wood products, plastics, basic chemicals and biotechs.
Anatomy Of A Base And The Breakout That Followed Going back to Ensign Group, the small cap is leading a strong rally among long-term medical care stocks ahead of next week's critical midterm elections. Some observers believe that strong victories by the Democratic Party could benefit health care service providers .
Ensign surged more than 15% to 43.43 in volume running nearly four times usual levels. The move took shares well past a 40.19 buy point in a three-month-long flat base .
In that base, the stock declined just 13.5% from a peak of 40.09 (the left side of the flat base) to a low of 34.69. That fits the requirement of no more than a 15% correction within the base.
The Mission Viejo, Calif., firm reported a 28% jump in earnings to 46 cents a share on a 9% revenue increase to $514.4 million.
In the prior four quarters, earnings lifted 13%, 33%, 32% and 42% vs. year-ago levels. Such numbers adequately meet the C in IBD's CAN SLIM seven-point paradigm for growth investing.
Other Financial Markets Ahead of the Nov. 4 sanctions led by the U.S. on Iranian oil exports, crude oil futures continue to plummet.
West Texas Intermediate crude oil near-term futures slid more than 2.5% to $63.64 a barrel. That shrank WTI's year-to-date gain to a little more than 5%.
